checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CHECK-JOB: mining.submit job ID validation against active session jobs
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Establish a mining session via mining.subscribe and mining.authorize. 2. Receive a mining.notify with a valid job ID. 3. Submit mining.submit with the valid job ID - verify acceptance. 4. Submit mining.submit with a stale/expired job ID - verify rejection. 5. Submit mining.submit with a random/unknown job ID - verify rejection. 6. Submit mining.submit with a job ID from a different session - verify rejection. 7. Verify error responses do not leak information about valid job IDs.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP1571-PRECOND-004. Boundary edge: EDGE-CHECK-JOB. External miner submits work via Stratum protocol.

checklist.title: Verify internal job ID validation logic rejects all invalid job references
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Inspect the job ID validation logic. 2. Verify job IDs are stored in a session-scoped cache. 3. Verify expiration of old job IDs when new mining.notify arrives. 4. Test concurrent sessions with overlapping job IDs.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP1571-PRECOND-004. Supporting node for boundary edge EDGE-CHECK-JOB.

checklist.title: Verify session ID uniqueness and unpredictability after mining.subscribe
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call mining.subscribe multiple times and collect session IDs. 2. Verify no two session IDs are identical. 3. Verify session IDs have sufficient entropy (not sequential). 4. Verify the session is recorded in the server's session cache. 5. Attempt to use a guessed session ID for mining.submit - must fail.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP1571-POSTCOND-002. Related: AMB-EIP1571-01. Post-condition: verify session establishment side-effects.

checklist.title: Verify session resumption restores extranonce and jobs without re-authorization
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Establish session, receive extranonce and jobs. 2. Disconnect. 3. Reconnect and call mining.subscribe with previous session ID. 4. Verify same session ID is returned. 5. Verify extranonce is restored. 6. Verify active jobs are restored. 7. Verify no re-authorization is required. 8. Submit work against a restored job - must succeed.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP1571-POSTCOND-004. Related: AMB-EIP1571-01. Post-condition: verify session restoration completeness.

checklist.title: Bypass SLOAD gas check by executing with exactly 799 gas remaining
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a call context with exactly 800 gas remaining. Execute SLOAD - must succeed. 2. Construct with 799 gas remaining. Execute SLOAD - must fail with out-of-gas. 3. Verify the charged cost is exactly 800 (EIP-1884 repriced), not 200 (legacy). 4. Test contracts compiled pre-EIP-1884 that hardcode 200 gas for SLOAD - verify they revert.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP1884-PRECOND-001. Related: ASSUM-EIP1884-02. Pre-condition falsification: insufficient gas for repriced SLOAD.

checklist.title: Violate SELFBALANCE equivalence: must return same value as BALANCE(ADDRESS) at lower gas cost
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract that calls both SELFBALANCE and BALANCE(address(this)) in the same transaction. 2. Verify both return identical values. 3. Verify SELFBALANCE costs 5 gas and BALANCE costs 700+ gas. 4. Test during value transfers (mid-call balance changes). 5. Test in delegate-call context (SELFBALANCE should reflect delegatecall recipient, not caller).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP1884-INV-002. Invariant falsification: attempt to get different values from SELFBALANCE vs BALANCE.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-COMPUTE-TIMESTAMP: block timestamp must exceed parent timestamp before difficulty calculation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a block with timestamp equal to parent timestamp. Verify rejection. 2. Submit a block with timestamp less than parent timestamp. Verify rejection. 3. Submit a block with timestamp = parent + 1. Verify acceptance. 4. Verify the difficulty adjustment factor uses the validated timestamp difference. 5. Test with timestamp far in the future to check upper bound handling.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP100-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge: EDGE-COMPUTE-TIMESTAMP. Related: ASSUM-EIP100-01.

checklist.title: Verify timestamp validation occurs before difficulty computation begins
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace the code path from block receipt to difficulty calculation. 2. Confirm timestamp validation precedes any arithmetic on the timestamp. 3. Test that an invalid timestamp does not partially compute difficulty before rejecting.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP100-PRECOND-001. Supporting node for EDGE-COMPUTE-TIMESTAMP.

checklist.title: Violate uncle factor invariant: must be 1 (no uncles) or 2 (with uncles), no other values
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Compute difficulty for a block whose parent has 0 uncles. Verify uncle factor = 1. 2. Compute for parent with 1 uncle. Verify uncle factor = 2. 3. Compute for parent with 2 uncles. Verify uncle factor = 2 (not 3). 4. Verify no code path allows uncle factor = 0 or > 2. 5. Test with manipulated uncle count in header.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP100-INV-001. Invariant falsification: attempt to produce uncle factor outside {1, 2}.

checklist.title: Bypass warm/cold access list check for external account opcodes (BALANCE, EXTCODESIZE, etc.)
checklist.bug_class: Gas undercharge via access list bypass
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Access an address not in the access list via BALANCE. Verify cold gas cost charged. 2. Access the same address again. Verify warm gas cost charged (100). 3. Pre-warm an address via access list. Verify first access charges warm cost. 4. Test EXTCODESIZE, EXTCODECOPY, EXTCODEHASH all follow the same access list check.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-PRAGUEENV-PRECOND-001. Related: AMB-PRAGUE-ENV-02, ASSUM-PRAGUE-ENV-02. Pre-condition falsification: bypass access list lookup.

checklist.title: Verify BLOBHASH returns correct hash for valid index and zero for out-of-bounds
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create a type-3 transaction with 3 blob versioned hashes. 2. Execute BLOBHASH(0), BLOBHASH(1), BLOBHASH(2) - verify correct hashes. 3. Execute BLOBHASH(3) - verify zero is pushed. 4. Execute BLOBHASH(MAX_UINT256) - verify zero is pushed. 5. Test in a non-blob transaction context (no blob_versioned_hashes) - all indices return zero.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-PRAGUEENV-POSTCOND-002. Related: ASSUM-PRAGUE-ENV-03. Post-condition: verify correct hash or zero on stack.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX: sender CodeHash must be EMPTYCODEHASH before transaction acceptance
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract at address X. 2. Craft a transaction with sender = X (requires private key collision or test setup). 3. Submit via eth_sendRawTransaction. 4. Verify rejection because CodeHash != EMPTYCODEHASH. 5. Verify the check occurs before nonce/balance validation to avoid information leakage. 6. Test with SELFDESTRUCT'd contract (CodeHash should be EMPTYCODEHASH after destruction).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3607-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge: EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX from EXT-USER-JSON-RPC to EL via eth_sendRawTransaction. Related: ASSUM-EIP3607-02.

checklist.title: Verify CodeHash retrieval returns correct value for sender validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Query CodeHash for a known EOA - must return EMPTYCODEHASH. 2. Query CodeHash for a known contract - must return non-empty hash. 3. Query CodeHash for a non-existent account - must return EMPTYCODEHASH (allows new accounts to transact).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3607-PRECOND-001. Supporting node for EDGE-USER-SUBMIT-TX.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-BLOCK-FROM-PEER: all block transactions must pass EIP-3607 sender code check
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a block containing one transaction from a contract account sender. 2. Propagate via P2P. 3. Verify the receiving node rejects the entire block. 4. Test with the invalid transaction at various positions (first, middle, last). 5. Verify that one invalid transaction invalidates the whole block, not just the transaction.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3607-PRECOND-003. Boundary edge: EDGE-BLOCK-FROM-PEER from network peers to EL.

checklist.title: Verify block transaction validation iterates all transactions for EIP-3607 check
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a block with 100 valid transactions and 1 invalid (contract sender) at position 99. 2. Verify the block is still rejected. 3. Confirm validation does not short-circuit on the first valid transaction.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3607-PRECOND-003. Supporting node for EDGE-BLOCK-FROM-PEER.

checklist.title: Bypass EIP-3607 code check via non-standard transaction submission path
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a transaction via eth_sendRawTransaction - verify code check occurs. 2. Submit via eth_call (simulation) - verify code check is NOT enforced (eth_call allows contract senders). 3. Attempt to find other RPC methods that accept transactions and verify they enforce the check. 4. Verify internal transaction processing (e.g., from block import) also enforces the check.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP3607-INV-002. Invariant falsification: attempt to bypass code check via alternative paths.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for gossip signature: BLS signature on SignedInclusionList must be valid
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a valid SignedInclusionList with correct BLS signature. Verify acceptance. 2. Modify one byte of the signature. Verify rejection with peer score penalty. 3. Use a valid signature from a different validator. Verify rejection. 4. Use a valid signature over different data. Verify rejection. 5. Verify the peer score is penalized on invalid signature (not just message dropped).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7805-PRECOND-004. Boundary: gossip network to CL. Signature verification at trust boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for gossip timing: inclusion list messages must arrive before attestation due time
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send a valid SignedInclusionList before attestation due time. Verify acceptance. 2. Send the same message after attestation due time. Verify it is IGNORED (not rejected with penalty). 3. Test at the exact boundary of attestation due time. 4. Test with clock skew between nodes. 5. Verify late messages are not processed or stored.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7805-PRECOND-005. Boundary: gossip timing constraint. Related: ASSUM-EIP7805-P2P-01.

checklist.title: Violate block context opcode invariant: all must charge GAS_BASE (2) and push one 256-bit value
checklist.bug_class: Gas cost or stack behavior error
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute each opcode (COINBASE, TIMESTAMP, NUMBER, PREVRANDAO, GASLIMIT, CHAINID) and measure gas consumed. 2. Verify each charges exactly 2 gas. 3. Verify each pushes exactly one 256-bit value to stack. 4. Verify stack depth increases by exactly 1 for each. 5. Test at max stack depth (1024) to trigger overflow.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-PRAGUEBLK-INV-001. Related: ASSUM-BLOCK-01. Invariant falsification: find opcode with wrong gas or stack behavior.

checklist.title: Trigger stack overflow/underflow in block context opcodes
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute COINBASE with stack at 1024 elements. Verify stack overflow error. 2. Execute BLOCKHASH with empty stack. Verify stack underflow error. 3. Verify all push-only block opcodes check overflow before pushing. 4. Verify BLOCKHASH checks underflow (needs 1 input) before overflow.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-PRAGUEBLK-INV-003. Invariant falsification: trigger stack boundary violations.

checklist.title: Violate bitwise opcode gas invariant: all must charge exactly GAS_VERY_LOW (3)
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute each bitwise opcode (AND, OR, XOR, NOT, BYTE, SHL, SHR, SAR) and measure gas. 2. Verify each charges exactly 3 gas regardless of operand values. 3. Test with operands = 0, MAX_UINT256, and random values. 4. Verify the cost is constant (not data-dependent).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-CANCUNBIT-INV-001. Related: ASSUM-CANCUN-BIT-02. Invariant falsification: find bitwise op with wrong gas cost.

checklist.title: Verify shift overflow behavior: SHL/SHR return 0, SAR returns 0 or MAX based on sign bit
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute SHL(256, x) for any x. Verify result is 0. 2. Execute SHR(256, x) for any x. Verify result is 0. 3. Execute SAR(256, positive_number). Verify result is 0. 4. Execute SAR(256, negative_number). Verify result is 2^256-1. 5. Test with shift = 257, MAX_UINT256. 6. Test boundary: shift = 255 (should NOT overflow).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-CANCUNBIT-POSTCOND-004. Post-condition: verify overflow behavior for large shifts.

checklist.title: Verify PUSH_N pushes correct big-endian value and advances PC by 1+N
checklist.bug_class: Incorrect bytecode reading or PC advancement
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute PUSH1 0xff. Verify 0xff on stack and PC advanced by 2. 2. Execute PUSH32 with known 32-byte value. Verify correct value and PC advanced by 33. 3. Execute PUSH1 at the end of bytecode (truncated immediate). Verify correct handling. 4. Verify big-endian conversion: PUSH2 0x0102 should push 258, not 513.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-PRAGUESTACK-POSTCOND-001. Related: ASSUM-PRAGUE-STACK-02. Post-condition: verify stack and PC state after PUSH.

checklist.title: Bypass SWAP_N stack depth validation with insufficient stack elements
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute SWAP1 with only 1 element on stack. Verify StackUnderflowError. 2. Execute SWAP1 with 2 elements. Verify success. 3. Execute SWAP16 with 16 elements. Verify underflow. 4. Execute SWAP16 with 17 elements. Verify success. 5. Verify gas is charged before the stack depth check.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-PRAGUESTACK-PRECOND-002. Pre-condition falsification: insufficient stack depth for SWAP.

checklist.title: Violate PC increment invariant: PC must only change via explicit increment operations
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute a sequence of POP, DUP1, SWAP1, PUSH1 operations. 2. Log PC value after each instruction. 3. Verify POP/DUP/SWAP advance PC by exactly 1. 4. Verify PUSH_N advances PC by exactly 1+N. 5. Verify no stack operation (POP, DUP, SWAP) modifies the PC by any amount other than 1. 6. Test that stack overflow/underflow errors do not leave PC in an inconsistent state.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-PRAGUESTACK-INV-004. Related: ASSUM-PRAGUE-STACK-03. Invariant falsification: find PC corruption during stack operations.
